snippet.title: Legion Breaker - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Unlock powerful spells, raise a holy army, and crush undead hordes in Legion Breaker. Lead your forces through battlefields that get bigger and bigger until you face the Necromancer King himself. Will you become the ultimate battlemage? 
Legion Breaker launches October 13, 2026 - wishlist on Steam now.
